Body.Content:
Streamline self-billing by automatically creating, managing, and exchanging electronic documents for self-billed invoices as part of the invoice lifecycle. This reduces manual document handling while helping ensure self-billed transactions include the appropriate electronic documents in standardized formats used by local regulations and trading partners.

Benefits

• Automate electronic document generation and handling for self-billed invoices.

• Integrate electronic documents directly into the self-billing invoice lifecycle.

• Support consistent vendor communications and the use of standardized electronic document formats.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
